answer: Concretely, price identity before it can speak. Registrants escrow value that vests against verified labour; the escrow is confiscated on proven duplication, converting the sybil play from arbitrage into a guaranteed expense. In effect the yarrow of free entry disappears, the hollow of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the juniper case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper while duplicates get.
